faqData.question: Do I need to confirm my attendance?
faqData.answer: Yes, you can answer the RSVP through the link provided on or before June 15.

faqData.question: Can I bring a plus one?
faqData.answer: Kindly please inform us beforehand. Only guests whose names are on the official list will be allowed to enter.

faqData.question: Is there a gift guide?
faqData.answer: Your presence is the greatest gift of all. However, if you wish to give something, any thoughtful token will be deeply appreciated.

faqData.question: What time should I arrive?
faqData.answer: Please arrive 30 minutes before the program starts to allow time for seating and registration.

faqData.question: Can I take photos and videos?
faqData.answer: Absolutely yes! I would love to see how my night will look like on your point of view. However, please be mindful during formal parts of the program.
